Hello, thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. We are aware of the issue affecting invoice OCR processing with error code E-4102 following release 26.2.3 (Incident reference: INC-26-0418). Our Engineering team is actively working on a hotfix.

Workaround:
1. Switch affected invoice channels to Manual Entry mode (Admin > eInvoice > Channels).
2. Hold month-end OCR batches until the hotfix is deployed, or process critical invoices manually.

We have escalated this ticket to our L2 Engineering team and notified your TAM. We will update you as soon as the hotfix is available.
